semantics: remaining deck shuffled to a hidden deal before source bidding
RuleBased/Conservative 50:50 source bidding runs from the initial bidding state
only naturally reached candidate-turn states with a current bid are collected
visible bidding context from that source state is used as model input
teacher rollout only fixes candidate=Napoleon, contract owner=candidate, target/suit=evaluated legal raise
no downstream bidding during teacher rollout
adjutant selection, exchange/bury, and play use normal rules
no post-history hidden-hand reshuffle and no repeated N=50 hidden-deal averaging

evaluation.selectionRationale: 50k had the best 5,000-game candidate relative reward among promoted candidates, no safety failures, #421 sign tied with 5k while reducing false PASS from 7 to 6, and #422 opening remained at 88.9% sign / 0 false PASS / 5 false BID. Held-out metrics plateaued rather than improved monotonically, so this is a modest data-scale gain, not an architecture/reward/runtime change.

frozenPolicy.intendedUse: repo-managed frozen bidding margin artifact for future benchmark/runtime references
frozenPolicy.retrainPolicy: Do not retrain bidding AI unless a new clear issue is found.
